description: This file provides a utility function 'inferColumns' for generating column definitions for a DataTable component based on provided data rows, an allowlist of fields, and optional configuration such as date fields. It analyzes data to determine which fields should be displayed and how to label and render each column.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Generates a list of column definitions for a DataTable by intersecting the data fields with an allowlist, with special rendering rules for date fields.
